items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: And that was when I first met Armand Hug. I was seven, he was fifteen.

ctx.x: Yeah. What about, uh, what's the first time you ever remember hearing jazz, either on records or live or whatever?

Well, of course it had to be live, because I can't remember any time when I didn't hear jazz. There was no way that you could grow up in the French Quarter and not hear jazz, just walking around in the street. And, uh, especially I remember, uh, when I was a kid, there were so many skiffle bands playing in the streets, there were people to throw them coins, you know. And, uh, that was the sound. That was the, and of course I used to go down by the Fern Dance Hall and stand across the street and listen to the band…
So you were, uh, you were wandering around in the, uh, in the quarter. Where did you live in the corner?
